tasks.label: NotebookFlow: build NotebookFlow.exe (x64)
args: if not exist build mkdir build && "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" && cl /nologo /EHsc /MT /Zi /utf-8 /c /D_STATIC /I "${workspaceFolder}" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\data" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\json" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\kstring" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\thread" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\dtime" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\parser" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\interpretor" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\flow" /I "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\dfile" Main.cpp /Fobuild\ && cd build && link /nologo /OUT:NotebookFlow.exe Main.obj "${workspaceFolder}\..\libUtil\build-util\util.lib" ws2_32.lib iphlpapi.lib dbghelp.lib && copy /Y NotebookFlow.exe "${workspaceFolder}\NotebookFlow.exe"
